parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description: The code of the service to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: RenewPeriod
parameters.description:
The duration of the subscription renewal. Unit: months. Valid values:

*   1 to 9
*   12
*   24
*   36

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi renew-instance --product-code rds --instance-id rm-skjdhaskjdh --renew-period 6 --client-token ASKJHKLASJHAFSLKJH --product-type rds --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi RenewInstance --region cn-hangzhou --ProductCode rds --InstanceId 'rm-skjdhaskjdh' --ProductType rds --RenewPeriod 6 --ClientToken ASKJHKLASJHAFSLKJH
